gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Eater brings a dark, aggressive snarl with wide gaps between its letters and thin strokes that never turn to hairlines. Noto Sans Bhaiksuki follows in a plain sans with tightly coiled lowercase, so paragraphs read smoothly and approachably.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Eater growls, with thin strokes and weighty stems. Noto Sans Brahmi settles into a long read with a high mean line and curves left open, contemporary and low in contrast.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-buginese: Noto Sans Buginese keeps its letter mouths open like unjoined chalk arcs, modern and low in contrast. Eater, though, swells mildly like a worn felt marker, and its dark, aggressive mood makes paragraphs feel like a different room.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Dark menace meets daylight. Eater does its best work with its wide-spaced, medium-low stress letters at display scale, while Noto Sans Buhid, a plain sans with generous curve openings and a high-set x-height, is built for steady reading.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-carian: Noto Sans Carian reads clean and professional, with terminals held apart like open scissor blades. Beside it, Eater's sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones add a dark, aggressive edge, so the two feel like a growl followed by a clear voice.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Approachable, first of all, is how Noto Sans Chakma feels, with its lowercase packed up toward the caps. Eater snarls through soft contrast in every curve, and Noto Sans Chakma, a plain sans with open mouths on its s and c, is the one that keeps text easy going.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Professional and approachable, Noto Sans Cherokee sits in a tall band of letters with short stalks above. Eater is the one to bring dark, aggressive attitude in its sturdy hairlines, while Noto Sans Cherokee, a sans-serif with a wide gap at the e terminal, keeps the text friendly.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Noto Sans Chorasmian has a large x-height, short ascenders and curves that stop short of closing. Eater, with stems only a shade heavier than its connecting arms, earns its keep when it runs big and brief.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Noto Sans Coptic reads clean and contemporary, its middle zone dominating each line, and its s and c stay open. And Eater adds a dark, aggressive rasp, like a worn charcoal stick pressed lightly into the heading.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Eater lays down dark, aggressive letters with in-between stroke contrast and wide gaps between each one. Noto Sans Deseret, a plain sans with open apertures and a wide-looking lowercase, makes paragraphs feel approachable.
